name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for my garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for my garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, prioritize experience with garage conversions and ADUs, especially in your local area. Look for proper licensing, insurance, and a strong portfolio of similar projects. Client testimonials and references are vital. Ensure clear communication, a detailed contract outlining scope and costs, and a transparent approach to project management. Obtain multiple bids to compare expertise and pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with ADU conversion experience, proper licensing, insurance, and strong references. Prioritize clear communication and a detailed contract.
